name: Pattern engine

dependencies.reason: event model, flatten(), chop snapshot, policy interface, RNG, byte codec, time, undo stack

threading: UI/worker thread only. Not real-time safe; the audio side consumes only the flattened events.
platforms: Any C++17 compiler. Output is bit-identical across platforms (integer and exact-double arithmetic only; a golden hash test pins it).
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/pattern_engine -B build/pattern_engine && cmake --build build/pattern_engine && ctest --test-dir build/pattern_engine
summary: Deterministic hierarchical pattern model (phrase, bar, beat, event), Generate and Mutate with locks, edit commands, flattening to a bounded event list, validation, versioned state, and an undo/redo + A/B session.
public_api: `generate(chops, settings, policy)` and `mutate(pattern, chops, options, policy)`
`PatternSession`: undo/redo and two A/B snapshot slots

`setEventFx()`, `setBarEvents()` (replace a bar, e.g. a Fractal Rhythm bar), `reserveIds()`; effect settings `allowFilter/allowGlide/allowCrunch/fxIntensity` (optional trailing state, absent when off)
limits: Pattern length 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars; grids 1/1 to 1/32, straight or triplet
512 events per pattern (configurable down), retrigger 2-8, pitch range up to 24 semitones, micro-shift up to one eighth of a grid cell
adapter_notes: Pass chop snapshots in, consume `flatten()` output in your scheduler; choose the seed source yourself. Engine version is stored with every pattern so algorithm changes never silently rewrite old patterns.
removal: Remove the composition root and `plugin_ui_adapter` first.
